review_basis: Direct inspection of the three original-resolution r34 PNG boards after unifying profiled surfaces and ordinary mass volumes under one opaque normal-shaded solid preview, recursive geometry synthesis, joint scope/phenotype selection, and same-source legal/FAR/parking evaluation.
render_expression_regression: The former mixed X-ray presentation was causal: profiled program-section faces used alpha 150 and ordinary prism sides/top used alpha 105/185 while recursive kernel meshes used alpha 255. All three paths now use the same opaque normal-shaded material.

neighborhood.measured: 20/20, 19 BOOK principles, 14 visual languages, six p.3 scopes, zero near-duplicate pairs; curved 1, oblique 2, prismatic 6, stepped 4, voided 4, winged 3.
neighborhood.visual_verdict: Courtyard, curve, branch, notch, stepped and oblique alternatives coexist and all are now rendered as opaque solids, but several low prismatic/chamfer bodies retain a shared generic family.
neighborhood.remaining_limit: Street frontage, tenant subdivision, vertical circulation and public-ground section are not resolved.

gymnasium.measured: 20/20, 18 BOOK principles, 16 visual languages, six p.3 scopes, zero near-duplicate pairs; curved 1, oblique 3, prismatic 6, stepped 2, voided 4, winged 4; gable ridge 1, folded 1, barrel vault 1, stepped section 1.
gymnasium.visual_verdict: The gable is present and no longer fades into a translucent wireframe; winged, stepped, court, saw-cut and oblique halls coexist, though some long bars still read as generic clipped sheds in isometric view.
gymnasium.remaining_limit: Clear-span structure, roof daylight, entry/service circulation and spectator section remain unverified.

cultural.measured: 20/20, 20 BOOK principles, 15 visual languages, six p.3 scopes, zero near-duplicate pairs; curved 1, oblique 1, prismatic 5, stepped 5, voided 4, winged 4.
cultural.visual_verdict: Courtyard, paired gallery, curve, step and notch moves are present and consistently rendered, but several low chamfer/terrace bodies remain too close to the neighborhood vocabulary.
cultural.remaining_limit: Gallery sequence, art logistics, civic entry hierarchy and daylight section remain unresolved.

verdict: The renderer now presents every recursive mesh, program-section roof and ordinary mass volume with one opaque solid language, so the former missing-gable/X-ray impression is fixed. The extended CSG program, BOOK scope, clean-mass gate, and legal/parking pipeline produce 60/60 numerically valid alternatives, but direct image review still finds cross-program low-box/chamfer/terrace family resemblance. Competition-grade completion is explicitly rejected. Live OpenAI VLM revision was not run for this fingerprint.
